purpose: Wave-4 Kandarin + Fremennik permanent skilling unlocks still missing as first-class planner rows (or only present as thin region-boundary anti-rows). Covers Yanille/Wizards' Guild, Port Khazard Trawler, Gnome Stronghold Agility + glider network, Ranging Guild, Warforge Dig Site content hub, Fish Flingers + fishing outfit + Champion's tackle box, Neitiznot arctic pine, Penguin Agility Course, Astral altar + Lunar Isle hub, Jatizso mine, Blast Furnace, Dagannoth Kings dragon hatchet pressure, enchanted lyre travel, and Liquid Gold Nymph golden-mining-suit path. Does not re-author existing Fremennik lunar-spell micro-rows or Kandarin fishing-guild / deep-sea method rows.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary Equilibrium taxonomy geography. region_hints lists support pressure only. required_regions + region_requirement_type only when every listed region is a hard gate. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global as a region token.
policy.duplicate_guard: Grep-confirmed absent as first-class content ids: kandarin:wizards-guild, yanille-skilling-hub, fishing-trawler (only fishing-trawler-boundary hygiene exists), gnome-stronghold-agility, gnome-glider-network, ranging-guild, warforge-dig-site (only warforge-dig-site-boundary hygiene exists), fish-flingers, champions-tackle-box; fremennik:arctic-pine-woodcutting, penguin-agility-course, astral-altar, lunar-isle-hub, jatizso-mine, blast-furnace, dagannoth-kings-dragon-hatchet, enchanted-lyre, liquid-gold-nymph-path. kandarin:fishing-outfit exists in research as equipment — this pack re-emits a richer linked equipment row for Fish Flingers stack completeness (merge may skip if id collision preferred).
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise permanent tools, travel, shops, dig-site progression, outfit/tackle storage, and region-defining gather hubs that change self-sufficient skilling.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour. Unlock state, costs, requirements, and effects only. Training rates belong in training datasets.
policy.boundary_rule: fishing-trawler and warforge-dig-site are full content hubs. Boundary rows remain anti-region hygiene; do not delete them.
